home.heroTitle: Aligning Skills, Evidence and Industry Demand across Maharashtra
home.heroSubtitle: A state-level workforce intelligence platform bridging the gap between classroom training and industry requirements through practical, verified evidence.
home.step1Desc: Extract real-time hiring competencies directly from active job postings across Maharashtra.
home.step2Desc: Differentiates true skill deficiencies from knowledge that lacks credible practical evidence.
home.step3Desc: Provides role-specific practical tasks to generate verifiable proof of competency.
home.step4Desc: A verified record of demonstrated skills and employer validations.
home.step5Desc: Equips institutes and planners to adjust seats, labs, and curricula using predictive what-if modeling.
home.differenceTitle: Key Differentiator: Skill Gap vs. Evidence Gap
home.skillGapExplain: A candidate does not possess or understand the required technical skill.
home.evidenceGapExplain: A candidate understands the concept or completed coursework, but lacks employer-accepted practical proof.
home.experienceBridgeExplain: Experience Bridge assigns realistic workplace simulation scenarios, enabling candidates to turn Evidence Gaps into verified competencies.

candidate.dashboardSubtitle: A real-time assessment of your target role requirements, demonstrated evidence, and priority actions.
candidate.q1: What does the market require for your target role?
candidate.q2: What skills can you currently demonstrate with evidence?
candidate.q3: Which skills are blocked by an evidence gap versus a knowledge gap?
candidate.q4: What is the single most effective action you should take next?
candidate.evidenceGapAlert: You have 1 skill with an Evidence Gap (AWS). Complete a practical task on the Experience Bridge to earn verified employer status.
candidate.skillGapAlert: You have 2 Skill Gaps (Networking, Docker). Enroll in practical training pathways to build foundational competency.

gapAnalysis.title: Skill vs. Evidence Gap Engine
gapAnalysis.subtitle: Clear separation between missing knowledge and missing verification proof.
gapAnalysis.demonstratedMeaning: Verified Practical Evidence: The candidate has completed authenticated technical scenarios evaluated with passing scores.
gapAnalysis.evidenceGapMeaning: Evidence Gap: Theoretical knowledge or certification exists, but no verifiable workplace performance record has been provided.
gapAnalysis.skillGapMeaning: Skill Gap: Neither coursework nor practical familiarity is demonstrated for the target role requirement.

experienceBridge.title: Experience Bridge
experienceBridge.subtitle: Convert evidence gaps into employer-validated practical competencies through role-specific scenario tasks.
experienceBridge.submissionPlaceholder: Detail your diagnostic process, commands executed, root cause identification, and resolution verification...
experienceBridge.artifactUrl: External Evidence URL (Git repository, terminal log, or documentation)
experienceBridge.successMsg: Evidence submitted successfully. Verification status has been updated in your Competency Passport.

passport.disclaimer: This credential represents validated task assessments under SWAMARGA public guidelines. It does not replace statutory degree certification.
